newsitem.title: USA: Optical Sensors gets U.S. FDA approval.
newsitem.headline: Optical Sensors gets U.S. FDA approval.

text.p: Optical Sensors Inc said it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its new OpticalCAM arterial blood gas monitoring instrumentation in the United States.
In conjunction with Optical Sensors' SensiCath Sensor, the OpticalCAM provides a fully integrated system for measuring and monitoring arterial blood gas.
The company also said it expects to begin distribution of the OpticalCAM in European markets during the first quarter.
The SensiCath Sensor, which received FDA clearance to market in January 1996, is an arterial blood gas monitoring system, which provides results within 60 seconds.
